assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states the motivational anchor (save people so the world is less frightening; the impulse predates OFA, MI01), early and later feared selves (the powerless dreamer; the cause of friends' danger and the rescuer who fails to reach someone), and a conditional hierarchy in which visible need can override score, rules, caution and bodily preservation while experience adds questions of who should act and what the other person needs (MI02-04). Repeated decision rules are located: rescue before feasibility (V01:p43-59, p107-114), self-preservation entering rescue ethics (腕は犠牲に出来ない V02:p163), the integrated ideal 必ず勝って 必ず助ける (V14:p149-151), distributed routes when relationship-compatible (V11:p020-025), strategically articulate self-exclusion (V28:p129-156, V29:p156-160, V32:p185-213) and agency without self-sufficiency (V41). The model rejects both 'always immediate contact' (first Eri encounter, V15:p019-020) and 'always strategy'. Not A: the one formal probe (MI-V01) is retrospective and nonblind, with action and speech partial, and the model says it cannot certify a universal rescue ability. Not C: goals, feared selves and conditional policies are explicit, state-separated and repeated across V01-V42.

The model gives six governed states (Quirkless aspirant; developing student V01-V20; multiple-Quirk successor V21-V30; departure and Dark Deku V31-V33; final war V34-V41; V42 aftermath and adult teacher), and the class ledger carries dated deltas for nearly every volume, with the readiness index tracing emerging -> moderate at V02, moderate -> strong at V11 and strong -> specialist_ready at V32, and recording why promotion was withheld at V29-V31. Transitions are located: permanent-arm warning (V10:p074-075) and first injury-free crisis (V11:p124-126), plural inheritance (V23:p008-013), Danger Sense onset (V30:p175), departure (V31:p210-213), help-receiving reintegration (V33:p061-074), relinquishment (V41:p049-051), loss of embers (V42:p129) and teaching with armor (V42:p158-160). Not A: V24, V27 and V36 lack a class-ledger Midoriya entry, V16-V17 and V39 are thin, the adult interval is undated, and adult medical limits are OPEN. Not C: the state changes are located, ordered and protected by explicit back-projection rules.

The model and the vocabulary ledger give a 僕-based register with role-appropriate politeness, familiar かっちゃん across every Bakugo state, hesitation, muttering and analytical overflow, and sharper directness under rescue pressure, with located contrasts: moral declarative speech when personhood is appropriated (轟くんも あなたじゃない V05:p039-043), a relationship-specific boundary (怒鳴らないでよ!! V07:p166-167), roughened Bakugo-shaped competitive speech (V14:p033), panic compression (止まれ V22:p167), the unreliable 僕は大丈夫だから (V33:p019-023), anti-erasure (泣いていた君を 見なかった事には しない V38:p078), unornamented 嫌だ (V40:p081), 人だよ (V41:p019) and adult reflection (先生っていいな V42:p159). The vocabulary ledger warns that final-arc moral speech stays short and concrete and that grandiose eloquence should be avoided. Not A: the ledger calls its strings retrieval aids whose glyphs must be rechecked on the page, MI-V01 found speech/register only partial, and the model says speech frequency and adult habits outside sampled settings remain uncertain. Not C: many located strings with register shifts tied to partner, urgency and state.

Located ordinary acts recur: watching classmates' exam recordings out of interest (V08:p069), accepting Aoyama's eccentric outreach once its intention is legible (MI11, V19:p020-023), returning straight to the class performance after containing Gentle (V20:p061-076), receiving Eri's letter and Inko's reassurance (V25:p123-126), the New Year reflection on ordinary conversation with Bakugo (V26:p168-169), the post-depletion bath and dorm sequence (V33:p157-169), and adult teaching, the Dai encounter and missed social cues (V42:p129-141, p156-161), with supplemental teaching and school-visit roles (MI-SUP-02). The model analyzes MI11 as a discriminative recipient policy and offers a medium-confidence ordinary-care reconstruction. Not B: the model says particular classroom decisions and private responses remain sparsely dramatized, profile facts constrain without being enacted scenes, and most ordinary samples are brief. Not D: there is an analyzed noncombat reception policy with repeated independent occasions.

The model's partner table and the relationship ledger give directional, dated states for Bakugo (V01 deference and refusal to abandon, V07 communication boundary, V13:p179-184 burden reception, V29-V30 diagnosis and regulation, V33 apology, V40:p089-104 launch, V42 missed invitation), All Might (admiration, survival covenant V15:p051, asymmetric care V32:p191-197, repair V33:p161), Iida (V07:p043 apology, V15:p170-172 support, V33 shared pace), Uraraka (V05 restored authorship, V23 rescue cost, V35:p041-057 symmetric disclosure, V42:p110-117, p177-183), Inko (unilateral risk allocation V32:p053-057, earned reassurance V25), Kota, Eri and Dai, Aoyama (V19, V34:p151-164), Endeavor (V30:p150-151), Shigaraki and Spinner (V30-V42), Lady Nagant, Chisaki and Toga (V35:p127-154). Not A: Inko and adult relationships are thin, Shigaraki's reciprocity stays OPEN by design, and validation is a single probe. Not C: the conditioning is explicit, discriminative and repeated across partners and periods.

Interiority rests on located self-disclosure and internal statements: recognizing his own present privilege (V04:p145-146), admitting mixed motive and frustration after the Todoroki match (V05:p102-103), the heart near its limit under confidentiality (V15:p169), relational fear in runaway power (誰にも心配させたくないのに V22:p167; admitted fear V23:p059-062), felt fortune (V26:p168-169), feeling rather than seeing a crying child behind Shigaraki (V31:p177-192), guilt-driven rage recentered by Mirio (V37:p064-082), and grief that Tenko's life was not saved alongside admitted adult loneliness (V42:p030-035, p129-141). The model separates ordinary anxiety, acute protection, anger and quiet or displaced grief. Not A: his 僕は大丈夫だから self-reports are explicitly unreliable (V33:p019-023), Dark Deku interior states are inferred from behavior, and MI-V01's emotional axis is one retrospective comparison. Not C: several independent self-disclosed inner states are located across periods.

Conflict regimes are located and differentiated: action-biased rescue with recursive analysis (V02:p159-170, p202-204), adaptive no-OFA competition (V03:p136-178), value-conditioned catastrophic expenditure (V09:p074-108), distributed noncombat extraction (V11:p020-025), triage and parallel rescue (V13:p019-044), the Ground Beta duel (V14:p020-039), counter-rate reasoning with Eri (V17:p184-189, V18:p007-039), quiet containment (V20:p043-076), civilian-protective decoy management (V28:p129-138), inquiry before stopping (V32:p037-041), regulated anger (V37:p064-082) and coercive intervention against refusal (V41:p069 onward). The model distinguishes analytical proliferation from immediate movement and requires stating capacities and whether deliberation is possible. Not A: outcomes in V18, V40 and V41 depended on Aizawa, Bakugo, Nana and classmates, and the only frozen prediction is MI-V01. Not C: conflict policy is explicit, repeated and state-conditioned.

Unlike a value assertion alone, several located episodes show weighing: accepting non-pursuit of Eri to protect the later rescue path while carrying moral residue (V15:p019-020, p143), reasoning that revealing himself as the target would divert heroes (V28:p134-138), answering Nana's kill question by acknowledging killings, that some people cannot be saved and that killing may be the only way, then choosing a rescue aim without claiming a method (V31:p177-192), separating immediate rescue from restitution for Chisaki (V32:p175-176), distinguishing Endeavor's permanent past from present effort without forgiving on others' behalf (V30:p150-151), and refusing to forgive Tomura's acts while carrying his message (V42:p019-020, p073-081). The model's rules (recognition is not permission, rescue eligibility is not innocence) are tied to these. Not A: the deliberations are mostly reconstructed by the analyst, the V41 justified-force tension is preserved as unresolved, and the V31-V32 unilateral risk allocation shows sound reasoning feeding a disabling policy. Not C: explicit trade-offs are located repeatedly across periods.

Located but local: the supplemental bonus shows an answering joke to Bakugo about their schooldays (MI-SUP-03, SUP-UAG-322-01), and ordinary embarrassment appears in the V33:p157-169 bath and dorm sequence. No item analyzes a play or humor policy, and the bonus fiction is an endpoint sample. Not D: there is no repeated analyzed comic regime. Not NOT_ASSESSED: the domain is affirmatively located, though only locally.

The set spans V01-V42 through dense class-ledger deltas, directional relationship states, lexical anchors, and a dedicated model of ten atoms with four discriminative supports (MI01a-c, MI11), three supplemental sections labeled by source class, two conditional reconstructions and one probe. Not B: V24, V27 and V36 lack a class-ledger Midoriya entry and V39 adds no direct state; the model excludes a profile page (V01:p110) from narrative support and records a printed-page offset for V31; the readiness index warns that imported eight-column rows inside older delta tables are historical defects, not valid freezes; the vocabulary strings are retrieval aids; and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection. Not D: coverage is continuous across every arc featuring him, and the model records its corrections openly.

Independent located limits: moral initiative is not solo success (All Might ends the sludge rescue, V01:p043-059; Uraraka arrests his fall, V01:p114); his 僕は大丈夫だから is not reliable condition reporting (V33:p019-023); inquiry is not compulsory redemption (Muscular stopped after refusing, V32:p037-041); recognition is not acquittal (V30:p188-192, V42:p019); Shigaraki's 拒絶 is real and his life was not saved (V41:p069 onward, V42:p030-035); Nana, not Midoriya, blocks Kotaro's strike (V41:p109-110); he cannot read Aoyama's thinking (V18:p182-183); friend harm can destabilize control (V30:p008-014); teaching is not a power-loss consolation (V42:p159); the armor is not restored OFA (MI-SUP-03); and there is no formal dating label (V42:p177-183). Not A: several limits are model inferences on a nonblind corpus, and limits in private adult life are thin. Not C: more than six independent limits are located with page and state. This grade is the one most worth testing for overgrading.

Knowledge and state gates are explicit: no OFA offer before V01:p069; incomplete OFA history early and vestige contact only from V21 with later mechanics excluded; the permanent-arm warning from V10:p074-075; Danger Sense from V30:p175; the V30 impression of Shigaraki is not the V41 causal disclosure; Aoyama's coercion is unknown before V34; V41 cannot know V42 survival or adult outcomes; stated Full Cowl baselines (5% to 8% at V14, about 30% with 45% at impact at V28:p148). The model requires stating OFA percentage, factors, fatigue, injury and equipment before any response, and keeps pre-OFA, early U.A., Dark Deku, final-war, embers, Quirkless-teacher and armored-teacher snapshots distinct. Not A: the adult interval is undated, and armor endurance and adult medical limits are unknown. Not C: the gates are located and enforced.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates many real formulations across registers and gives register rules (choose relation and urgency first; short concrete moral speech late; reflective adult explanation distinct from adolescent stammering). But the vocabulary ledger calls its strings retrieval aids whose glyphs must be rechecked on the Japanese page, the model says exact lexical imitation requires retrieving the relevant page and that speech frequency outside sampled settings is uncertain, MI-V01 found speech/register partial with terminal wording unpredicted, and generated dialogue would be illustrative prediction, never attributed quotation. Retrieving located lines is supported; writing new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Midoriya's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named snapshot, stated explicitly, with OFA possession and percentage, inherited factors, Danger Sense, injuries, knowledge of Shigaraki and Aoyama, and whether the V33 reintegration has happened fixed for it; later received help, relinquishment and adult outcomes are never moved earlier.

The interlocutor is named and handled as the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot; Bakugo-specific address and rivalry, and Shigaraki-specific rescue perception, are not generalized to other partners.
The setting is one of the located regimes, with available capacities and whether the emergency permits deliberation stated.

Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels, keeps self-exclusion and overextension as live risks where the snapshot has them, produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named snapshot, stated explicitly: Quirkless aspirant (V01 before transfer), developing U.A. student (V01-V20), multiple-Quirk successor (V21-V30), departure and Dark Deku (V31-V33), final war (V34-V41), or V42 aftermath and adult teacher with or without armor; OFA percentage and factors, Danger Sense, current injuries and arm risk, what he knows of Shigaraki, Aoyama and the OFA history, and whether the class has brought him back are fixed for that snapshot.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Bakugo, All Might, Iida, Uraraka, Todoroki, Inko, a child in distress or a pupil, a coerced or culpable opponent, or a mentor such as Gran Torino or Endeavor, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot; whether the partner can responsibly choose to share risk is stated.
setting_constraints: Imminent rescue, school training or competition, a raid or internship, war, a noncombat school event, reintegration among peers, or adult teaching and armored peer work
Capacities stated: OFA output and factors, fatigue and injury, support equipment, or the Quirkless adult state with or without the armor
No romance milestone, private adult routine, classroom disciplinary case or opponent interiority invented, and no rescue success or conversion assumed

scenario_readiness.note: Two conditional reconstructions are modeled: adult teacher Midoriya asked by a child with an unpromising Quirk (high from MI10, exact career outcome low) and a peer explaining a clumsy caring gesture after V19 (medium). MI-V01 supports one bounded continuity test. Transfer to a materially novel context is supported only for policies the model states with their triggers: move under visible imminent need, weigh restraint when immediate action would destroy a later rescue path, investigate causes without promising conversion, and (after V33) accept help when peers assert their own agency. Not READY: a single nonblind probe, two modeled reconstructions, and thin private adult evidence. Not NOT_READY: the policies are explicit, repeated and gated by state.

conditions: Setting is a Class 1-A peer exchange, a dorm or bath scene, a school event, a family exchange with Inko, or adult teaching and peer contact in a named snapshot.
Hesitation and embarrassment are not read as incapacity, and kindness is not read as instant insight into concealed motives (he could not read Aoyama before V19).
No domestic routine, classroom disciplinary case, leisure biography or private adult relationship is invented, and supplemental profile facts constrain without becoming enacted scenes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located ordinary interaction exists (V08:p069, V19:p020-023, V20:p061-076, V25:p123-126, V26:p168-169, V33:p157-169, V42:p129-141, p156-161) and MI11 states a discriminative reception policy with a medium-confidence reconstruction. Not READY: the model says particular classroom and private responses remain sparsely dramatized. Not NOT_READY: peer ordinary interaction is repeated and analyzed.

conditions: The dilemma concerns rescue against rules or strategy, restraint versus immediate action, stopping a culpable or coerced opponent while recognizing the person, or allocation of risk between himself and others, in a named snapshot.
Recognition is never converted into forgiveness on victims' behalf, acquittal or guaranteed conversion, and coercive intervention against refusal stays an unresolved tension.
Civic, legal and abstract policy dilemmas, and an adult teacher's institutional decisions, are not extrapolated beyond located positions.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported by located weighing (V15:p019-020, V28:p134-138, V30:p150-151, V31:p177-192, V32:p037-041, p175-176, V41:p069 onward, V42:p019-020). Not READY: the deliberations are analyst reconstructions validated only by a retrospective probe, and the V31-V32 risk allocation shows that sound reasoning can feed a disabling policy. Not NOT_READY: explicit trade-offs recur across periods.

Romance is affirmatively but narrowly located: the relationship ledger licenses no reciprocal Midoriya conclusion during Uraraka's contained attraction (V13:p024-025), and at V42:p169-183 it records a particular wish to talk more with Ochako, reciprocation and held hands as strong mutual movement with no formal dating or marriage label; the model OPENs future relationship milestones. The evidence is a single endpoint movement with an explicitly unlabeled status, so it bounds rather than enables reconstruction of romantic behavior.

conditions: Setting is training, licensing, internship or agency work, a raid, war, or adult teaching and armored peer work in a named snapshot, with capacities, injuries and equipment stated.

Accepting or delegating help is modeled as consistent with his agency after the located transitions (V11 distributed route, V33 reintegration, V40 launch, V41 dependence), and earlier unilateral burden ownership is preserved where the snapshot has it.

Outcomes that depended on others (All Might, Aizawa, Nana, Bakugo, classmates, the class-funded armor) are not reassigned to his solitary authorship, and specific classroom decisions are not invented.
scenario_readiness.note: Located professional regimes: license triage (V13:p019-044), Nighteye's office and the Eri raid (V14:p182-194, V15-V18), Endeavor's automaticity training (V25:p132-142, V26:p007-076), decoy pursuit management (V28:p129-138), war (V29-V41), adult teaching and armored work (V42:p129-141, p158-160; MI-SUP-02). The adult-teacher reconstruction is modeled. Not READY: one nonblind probe, and adult professional evidence is a narrow endpoint sample. Not NOT_READY: located and repeated.

known_limits.statement: Moral initiative does not mean he succeeds alone: All Might supplies the decisive sludge rescue (V01:p043-059), Uraraka arrests his fall after the zero-pointer (V01:p114), Aizawa is required to stop Rewind (V18:p007-039), and classmates construct the physical path to the final strike (V41:p179-195). The model forbids converting initiative into successful solo capability.

Under self-exclusion his 僕は大丈夫だから is not reliable condition reporting (V33:p019-023): he refuses food, rest and accompaniment while wounds accumulate (V32:p185-213), and the class ledger calls the failure policy, not perception.

Recognizing an opponent's suffering never acquits the acts: he remembers Shigaraki's killings while perceiving a request to be saved (V30:p188-192), says やった事を許せはしない (V42:p019), and distinguishes Endeavor's permanent past from present effort without forgiving on others' behalf (V30:p150-151).

Inquiry and reaching do not guarantee conversion or survival: Muscular rejects the premise and is stopped (V32:p037-041), Shigaraki's 拒絶 is real and his adult chosen bonds stand (V41:p069 onward, p113-123), and Tenko's life is not saved (V42:p030-035). The model REJECTs guaranteed rescue conversion.
Nana, not Midoriya, interrupts Kotaro's strike while he reaches Tenko (V41:p109-110); protective intent is evident, but the block must not be assigned to him.

Care for others does not give him insight into concealed motives: he cannot read Aoyama's attention (V18:p182-183) until Aoyama explains it (V19:p020-023), and he has no knowledge of Aoyama's coercion before V34.

Teaching is a vocation, not a consolation for power loss: he keeps teaching after receiving the armor and thinks teaching would have attracted him even had OFA remained (V42:p158-160); the armor is socially produced capacity, not restored OFA (MI-SUP-03).
V42:p169-183 shows strong mutual movement with Ochako and a particular wish to talk more, but no on-page dating or marriage label; future relationship milestones are OPEN.
No class-ledger Midoriya entry covers V24, V27 or V36, V39 records no direct state change, and V16-V17 are thin; behavior in those intervals is not established by this set.
Adult private life, specific classroom and disciplinary responses, armor endurance and adult medical limits are not evidenced beyond the V42 and supplemental endpoint samples.
The only formal validation (MI-V01) is a retrospective, nonblind chronological holdout; no blind or independent prediction test exists.

Within peer, school, family and adult-teaching ordinary settings the evidence gives discriminative policies, not only scattered acts: an awkward gesture becomes acceptable once its caring intention is legible, without granting him insight into concealed motives (MI11, V18:p182-183 -> V19:p020-023); protecting an ordinary event includes returning beneficiaries to it (V20:p061-076); received support is framed as the giver's effort (V25:p123-126); ordinary conversation with Bakugo is registered as fortune (V26:p168-169); depleted reintegration into bath and dorm life (V33:p157-169); and adult encouragement is concrete and adjusted to the child's ability (MI10, V42:p134-141), with missed social cues as an observed error (V42:p156-161). The model rates the adult-teacher reconstruction high and the V19 peer-care reconstruction medium. Not A: particular classroom decisions and private responses remain sparsely dramatized and most ordinary samples are brief. Not C: the policies state what changes his ordinary response and recur across independent occasions; the private-adult gap is recorded as a limit and restricts use.

Differentiated regimes: action-biased rescue with recursive analysis (V02:p159-170, p202-204), adaptive no-OFA competition (V03:p136-178), value-conditioned catastrophic expenditure (V09:p074-108), distributed noncombat extraction (V11:p020-025), triage and parallel rescue (V13:p019-044), the Ground Beta duel (V14:p020-039), counter-rate reasoning with Eri (V17:p184-189, V18:p007-039), quiet containment (V20:p043-076), civilian-protective decoy management (V28:p129-138), inquiry before stopping (V32:p037-041), regulated anger (V37:p064-082), enablement without substitution (V40:p081-104) and coercive intervention against refusal (V41:p069 onward). Several located episodes show weighing rather than assertion: accepting non-pursuit of Eri to protect the later rescue path while carrying moral residue (V15:p019-020, p143); reasoning that revealing himself as the target would divert heroes (V28:p134-138); answering Nana's kill question by acknowledging killings, that some people cannot be saved and that killing may be the only way, then choosing a rescue aim without claiming a method (V31:p177-192); separating immediate rescue from restitution for Chisaki (V32:p175-176); distinguishing Endeavor's permanent past from present effort without forgiving on others' behalf (V30:p150-151); refusing to forgive Tomura's acts while carrying his message (V42:p019-020, p073-081). The model also shows sound reasoning feeding a disabling policy (V31-V32 unilateral risk allocation), which a useful model must predict. Not A: the V41 justified-force tension is preserved as unresolved and civic or institutional dilemmas are unlocated. Not C: explicit trade-offs recur across periods and the evidence shows which consideration decides.

Located but local: the supplemental bonus shows an answering joke to Bakugo about their schooldays (MI-SUP-03, SUP-UAG-322-01), and ordinary embarrassment appears in the V33:p157-169 bath and dorm sequence. No item analyzes a play or humor policy, and the bonus fiction is an endpoint sample. Not D: there is no repeated analyzed comic regime. Not NOT_ASSESSED: the domain is affirmatively located, though only locally.

The set spans V01-V42 through dense class-ledger deltas, directional relationship states, lexical anchors and a dedicated model of ten atoms with four discriminative supports (MI01a-c, MI11), three supplemental sections labeled by source class, two conditional reconstructions and one probe. Not B: V24, V27 and V36 lack a class-ledger Midoriya entry and V39 adds no direct state, though he is the protagonist; the model excludes a profile page (V01:p110) from narrative support and records a printed-page offset for V31; and the readiness index declares imported eight-column rows inside older delta tables to be historical defects. Not D: coverage is continuous across every arc featuring him, and the corrections are recorded openly.

Independent located limits: moral initiative is not solo success (V01:p043-059, p114; V18:p007-039; V41:p179-195); 僕は大丈夫だから is not reliable condition reporting (V33:p019-023); inquiry is not compulsory redemption (V32:p037-041); recognition is not acquittal (V30:p188-192, V42:p019); Shigaraki's 拒絶 is real and his life was not saved (V41:p069 onward, V42:p030-035); Nana, not Midoriya, blocks Kotaro's strike (V41:p109-110); he cannot read Aoyama's thinking (V18:p182-183); friend harm can destabilize control (V30:p008-014); teaching is not a power-loss consolation (V42:p159); the armor is not restored OFA (MI-SUP-03); and there is no formal dating label (V42:p177-183). Not A: several limits are model inferences on a nonblind corpus, and limits in private adult life are thin. Not C: more than six independent limits are located with page and state.

Knowledge and state gates are explicit: no OFA offer before V01:p069; incomplete OFA history early and vestige contact only from V21, with later mechanics excluded; the permanent-arm warning from V10:p074-075; Danger Sense from V30:p175; the V30 impression of Shigaraki is not the V41 causal disclosure; Aoyama's coercion is unknown before V34; V41 cannot know V42 survival or adult outcomes; stated Full Cowl baselines (5% to 8% at V14, about 30% with 45% at impact at V28:p148). The model requires OFA percentage, factors, fatigue, injury and equipment before any response. Not A: the adult interval is undated, and armor endurance and adult medical limits are unknown. Not C: the gates are located and enforced.

conditions: Use is illustrative reconstruction of a named snapshot, never attributed quotation; any line presented as canon is retrieved from a located page.

Relation and urgency are chosen first, as the model directs: 僕-based speech with role-appropriate politeness and かっちゃん for Bakugo; hesitation and analytical overflow in ordinary anxiety; direct commands under rescue pressure; short concrete moral speech in the final arc; reflective explanation as an adult teacher.

Content is fixed by the snapshot's knowledge and capacities, and speech functions without a located model (romantic milestones, private adult routine, a classroom disciplinary case, Tomura's interior) are not generated.
scenario_readiness.note: The evidence constrains generated speech enough for illustrative use: many located lines across registers, partner-specific address, and explicit generation rules from the model and vocabulary ledger. MI-V01 found speech/register partial because terminal wording and adult fluency were underspecified, which is productive uncertainty about wording, not insufficiency about register. Not READY: the model says exact lexical imitation requires retrieving the page, speech frequency and adult habits outside sampled settings are uncertain, and broad ranges and romanized strings must be rechecked before quotation. Not NOT_READY: the predecessor's NOT_READY treated the use bound and the ledger's retrieval-aid caveat as findings that generation is unsupported; under the owner rulings they bound use and apply only to the strings named.

scenario_readiness.note: Transfer is supported for policies the model states with their triggers: move under visible imminent need; weigh restraint when immediate action would destroy a later rescue path; investigate causes without promising conversion; prefer a relationship-compatible distributed route when one is visible; and, after V33, accept help when peers assert their own agency. Two reconstructions are modeled: adult teacher Midoriya asked by a child with an unpromising Quirk (high from MI10, exact career outcome low) and a peer explaining a clumsy caring gesture after V19 (medium). MI-V01 is a bounded continuity test that confirmed motive, emotional trajectory and relationship handling. Not READY: private adult life, romance milestones and opponent interiority stay outside what the evidence predicts. Not NOT_READY: the policies are explicit, repeated, state-gated and predict his errors as well as his rescues.

known_limits.statement: Moral initiative does not mean he succeeds alone: All Might supplies the decisive sludge rescue (V01:p043-059), Uraraka arrests his fall after the zero-pointer (V01:p114), Aizawa is required to stop Rewind (V18:p007-039), and classmates construct the physical path to the final strike (V41:p179-195).

Under self-exclusion his 僕は大丈夫だから is not reliable condition reporting (V33:p019-023): he refuses food, rest and accompaniment while wounds accumulate (V32:p185-213), and the class ledger calls the failure policy, not perception.

Recognizing an opponent's suffering never acquits the acts: he remembers Shigaraki's killings while perceiving a request to be saved (V30:p188-192), says やった事を許せはしない (V42:p019), and distinguishes Endeavor's permanent past from present effort without forgiving on others' behalf (V30:p150-151).

Inquiry and reaching do not guarantee conversion or survival: Muscular rejects the premise and is stopped (V32:p037-041), Shigaraki's 拒絶 is real and his adult chosen bonds stand (V41:p069 onward, p113-123), and Tenko's life is not saved (V42:p030-035). The model REJECTs guaranteed rescue conversion.
Nana, not Midoriya, interrupts Kotaro's strike while he reaches Tenko (V41:p109-110); protective intent is evident, but the block must not be assigned to him.

Care for others does not give him insight into concealed motives: he cannot read Aoyama's attention (V18:p182-183) until Aoyama explains it (V19:p020-023), and he has no knowledge of Aoyama's coercion before V34.

Teaching is a vocation, not a consolation for power loss: he keeps teaching after receiving the armor and thinks teaching would have attracted him even had OFA remained (V42:p158-160); the armor is socially produced capacity, not restored OFA (MI-SUP-03).
V42:p169-183 shows strong mutual movement with Ochako and a particular wish to talk more, but no on-page dating or marriage label; future relationship milestones are OPEN.
No class-ledger Midoriya entry covers V24, V27 or V36, V39 records no direct state change, and V16-V17 are thin; behavior in those intervals is not established by this set.

Adult private life, specific classroom and disciplinary responses, armor endurance and adult medical limits are not evidenced beyond the V42 and supplemental endpoint samples; this restricts mundane, dialogue and professional use to the sampled settings.

The only formal validation (MI-V01, V41 -> V42) is a retrospective, nonblind chronological holdout that supported motive, emotional trajectory and relationship handling and was partial on action and speech; no blind or independent prediction test exists. This limits confidence, not the tier.
